title: AMBA CXS stream port: packets of 32-bit words in 4-word flits with START / END control, credit flow control, ACTIVEREQ / ACTIVEACK link activation and deactivation

fields.desc: activate the transmit side (cleared: deactivate at the next packet boundary)

regs.name: TX
regs.desc: Packet word to send; writing TX1 sends it (the core takes it when the flit being filled has room)

fdesc.tx_err: with tx_last: the packet ends with END_ERROR

regs.name: RX
regs.desc: Received packet word; reading RX1 pops it. While RX is not read the flit buffers fill and no credit is granted

fdesc.rx_err: with rx_last: END_ERROR, or a packet cut by a bad flit

fields.desc: transmit side: 0 STOP, 1 ACTIVATE, 2 RUN, 3 DEACTIVATE

irqs.name: CRD
irqs.desc: a flit without a credit, a credit returned beyond those granted, or a grant past 15 credits

irqs.name: CNTL
irqs.desc: a flit with bad START / END or no word used was dropped

notes: cxs_tx_* and cxs_rx_* are the CXS transmit and receive interfaces; they pass through unchanged.
The core parameter RXF (4) keeps its default.
